Ḥull. 65ᵃ ציפרתי נמי מִקְלַט קָלְטָא the tsipparti, too, snaps at things in the air (and yet it is a clean bird). Y. Pes. III, beg. 29ᵈ דיִקְלוֹט, v. צִבְעָא I; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 35:6">Targ. Y. Num. XXXV, 6</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Pesachim 52a:8">Pes. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>אטו גבא דחמרא קַלְטִינְהוּ</he> (not <cite ref="A00236"><he>אגבא</he></cite>) does the back of the ass (on which the fruit was brought to the place) form a sacred precinct (so that it cannot be exported again)?

<cite ref="Sukkah 49b">Succ. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>בדא׳</he> when the remnant of the libation poured into the depth was intercepted in a vessel; <cite ref="Meilah 11b:18">Meïl. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>דאי קְלַט</he> (<he>קתני</he>) it refers to a case when one intercepted the libation (v. Rashi a. Tosaf. for Var. Lect.).
